title: FizzBuzz word
prompt: Define a function that takes a natural number n of at least 1 and returns text: "FizzBuzz" if n is divisible by 15, "Fizz" if by 3, "Buzz" if by 5, and otherwise n written in decimal (for example "7"). Write a Hoon core (|% ... --) with one arm named fizzbuzz. Take a @ud and return a tape.
